_note: Authentic customer reviews copied verbatim from the previous website's 'Nos avis' page (source: Google reviews). Dates are as displayed on that page (relative) and were not available as absolute dates. Do not add reviews here without a verifiable source.

reviews.author: Arzo Karimi
reviews.text: Best service. Same day delivery. Very friendly staff and really good prices. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Raoul
reviews.text: Les meilleurs prix comparés à tous les autres magasins d'électroménager ! Un service client au top ! Leurs appareils sont neufs et impeccables ! Et je suis vraiment ravie de la livraison ! Je recommande vivement !

reviews.author: George Tamzarian
reviews.text: I was so satisfied with the service that I had there, and the prices are really low. And all the staff are in a good condition, highly recommend...

reviews.author: Brian Moten
reviews.text: Je suis extrêmement satisfait de ce produit ! Sa qualité et ses performances ont dépassé mes attentes. Le service client était excellent et la livraison rapide. Je le recommande vivement.
